actions.description: Create durable fence marker and preserve failed marker
actions.command:
cd /var/lib/failover
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, time
d = "/var/lib/failover"
# 1) Durable fence marker: old primary 127.0.0.1:8081 must never serve writes again.
fence = os.path.join(d, "primary.fenced")
data = (
    "state=fenced\n"
    "failed_primary=127.0.0.1:8081\n"
    "promoted_replica=127.0.0.1:8082\n"
    "fence_token=fence-%d\n"
    "fenced_at_epoch=%d\n" % (int(time.time()), int(time.time()))
).encode()
fd = os.open(fence, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o644)
os.write(fd, data); os.fsync(fd); os.close(fd)
# 2) Re-assert failed marker exists (preserve, never delete)
open(os.path.join(d, "primary.failed"), "a").close()
# fsync the directory so the new/updated dirents are d…

actions.description: Promote replica and switch proxy upstream durably
actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import os
d = "/var/lib/failover"
def atomic_write(path, content):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    fd = os.open(tmp, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC, 0o644)
    os.write(fd, content.encode()); os.fsync(fd); os.close(fd)
    os.replace(tmp, path)
atomic_write(os.path.join(d, "replica.role"), "primary\n")   # promote
atomic_write(os.path.join(d, "upstream"), "8082\n")           # switch proxy
dfd = os.open(d, os.O_RDONLY); os.fsync(dfd); os.close(dfd)
print("role =", repr(open(os.path.join(d,"replica.role")).read()))
print("upstream =", repr(open(os.path.join(d,"upstream")).read()))
PY
sync
